slides.hook: Down 0-1. Then Korea stole it in *13 minutes*.

slides.headline: Krejci silences Guadalajara
slides.body: Czechia waited a full hour to land the first punch. Krejci's goal on 59 minutes put South Korea on the wrong side of an *opening-day upset* — one goal down, half an hour to fix it.

annotations.text: 0-1 with 31 minutes left on the clock

slides.headline: Thirteen minutes that flipped the game
slides.body: Hwang In-beom levelled it on 67. Oh Hyeon-gyu finished the job on 80. Two goals in *thirteen minutes* — and a crowd that thought it was watching an upset got a comeback instead.

slides.context: Mexico 2-0 South Africa opened the tournament. Goals from Quinones and Jimenez — and *three* sendings-off before the night was done.
Quinones on 9 minutes, Jimenez on 67. Mexico eased past South Africa in front of a *packed* Estadio Azteca.

slides.note: Day 2 — Canada and the USA's openers — drops this afternoon.
